scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/compartido && concurrently -k -n compartido,api,web -c gray,blue,green "npm run dev -w packages/compartido" "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/compartido && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/compartido && npm test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.lint: eslint . && prettier --check . && npm run build -w packages/compartido && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
